findings.evidence: "- [ ] **Parameterized Queries**: SQL injection prevented" — the checklist carries generic DB hygiene (parameterized queries, least privilege, SELECT * avoided) that is off-topic for schema design and already known
findings.fix: Prune the Security, Performance and Documentation sections to schema-relevant checks only

findings.evidence: "identify engine/version, workload, scale, tenancy, retention, consistency needs" — a default is given only for engine (PostgreSQL); no labeled default assumptions when the user states none
findings.fix: Add default labeled assumptions (e.g. single-tenant, moderate scale, new schema) to state when context is missing

findings.evidence: "Never change token-like schema semantics silently" — 'token-like' is undefined and no example is given
findings.fix: Define it (columns whose values are opaque tokens or secrets) and add a one-line example

findings.evidence: "load only the relevant sections of an engine-specific reference if present" — no engine-specific reference exists in references/ (only migrations.md and schema-design-checklist.md)
findings.fix: Delete the pointer or add the engine-specific reference files it names

findings.evidence: "Check selectivity, column order, write amplification, and execution plans before adding one" — no default command is named for checking execution plans
findings.fix: Default to EXPLAIN (ANALYZE) on PostgreSQL and name the per-engine equivalents

findings.evidence: "- [ ] **Indexes on Foreign Keys**: All FKs are indexed" contradicts SKILL.md step 5 "Do not index every foreign key or low-selectivity field by reflex"; an agent validating per step 7 would add the indexes step 5 forbids
findings.fix: Reword to 'FK indexes justified by join/parent-delete cost and write impact' to match the SKILL.md policy
